title: Hugging Face Turns OpenAI Math into Open Source RL Environments
summary:
Researchers and developers can now use terms of reinforcement learning to train AI models using a dataset of mathematical challenges from OpenAI hosted on the Hugging Face platform. These tools transform a static research release into executable training infrastructure, allowing the community to build and refine open weights models more efficiently.

The current version is in an early stage, and the verifier only accepts the exact original formalization of a problem, meaning equivalent proofs may receive a score of 0. Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue described the initiative as an exciting direction for turning open research into usable environments for the broader AI community.
